name: RoofGS Quadratic Form Expansion and Coefficient Folding
definition: An optimization that expands the Gaussian quadratic form to separate pixel-dependent terms from Gaussian-dependent terms, allowing pixel coordinates to be hoisted out of the primitive loop and reducing instruction overhead in the innermost rendering loop.
summary: RoofGS Quadratic Form Expansion and Coefficient Folding is a rasterization optimization that pre-computes Gaussian parameters into folded coefficients, hoisting pixel terms to reduce instruction overhead in the innermost rendering loop.
